basic_info.description: 826 Jackson Street is a prominent Mixed-Use Property with 16 apartment units and 3 retail spaces.     The upper-floor residential units contain a high demand mix of 12 1 Bedrooms and 4 2-Bedrooms. The street retail feature high ceilings and a full height basement. The property boasts a substantial 11,100 SF building area on a 6,037 SF lot. Zoned CRNC (Chinatown Residential Neighborhood Commercial), its retail units are ideally positioned to provide space for services which support the community hospital across the street.    Residents have immediate and walkable access to the bustling Chinatown, North Beach, and Financial districts. The investment appeal of the property are its central location and large upside in both commercial and residential rents.
